headline: Xelpmoc Design And Tech files AGM voting results and scrutinizer report
summary: Xelpmoc Design And Tech Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The filing is a standard regulatory compliance requirement for listed entities. For Indian retail investors, routine AGM filings have negligible impact on stock price or business fundamentals.
why_it_matters: No direct financial impact on retail shareholders.
